extraction.name: LongBench
extraction.description: A bilingual, multi-task benchmark for evaluating long context understanding across 21 datasets and 6 task categories in English and Chinese. It standardizes datasets into a unified format for automatic evaluation of long-context LLMs.
extraction.creator: Yushi Bai, Xin Lv, Jiajie Zhang, Hongchang Lyu, Jiankai Tang, Zhidian Huang, Zhengxiao Du, Xiao Liu, Aohan Zeng, Lei Hou, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang, Juanzi Li
extraction.publisher: Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The benchmark was constructed by extracting test-set instances from public datasets, manually curating MultiFieldQA by collecting documents/articles from multiple sources and having three Ph.D. students annotate questions and answers, and building multi-document contexts by adding supporting and distracting passages and randomly ordering them.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Test sets from public datasets including NarrativeQA, Qasper, MultiFieldQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, DuReader, GovReport, QMSum, and MultiNews; for MultiFieldQA, documents and articles from multiple sources such as legal documents, government reports, encyclopedias, and academic papers; for DuReader, documents related to Baidu Search and Baidu Zhidao.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For MultiFieldQA, the authors manually curated English and Chinese datasets and invited three Ph.D. students to annotate the question and answer for each article, aiming for definitive answers and ensuring answers could be inferred from the documents. For MuSiQue, annotators paraphrased questions to avoid shortcuts and ensure linguistic naturalness.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Three Ph.D. students annotated each article/question-answer pair for MultiFieldQA.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Three Ph.D. students; also mentions NLP practitioners and native speakers for source datasets.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: We employ two extraction strategies: random sampling and uniform sampling.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For multi-document QA, supporting passages are included, distracting passages are added until the total length reaches a maximum length, and the passages are randomly ordered; for the Chinese dataset, several documents are arbitrarily selected as distractors until each question is associated with 20 documents.
